title: ActionOutcomePayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `action_outcome` (C5-02 outcome events, Proposed; provisional vocabulary like decisions 0033 and 0069): one small event per action the Body finished, success or failure, in the order they finished. The type is not `action` (that is the durable ActionRecord) nor `action_failed` (that is a wake reason): ok=true is the player's `action` entry, ok=false its `action_failed` entry. Fixed text only: message and why are built from the verb and reason code with fixed templates (contract/src/outcome-words.ts) and never quote world or agent text. A batch of at most 6 actions emits at most 6 of these, plus at most one for a failed intent. Events only, no table. source_event_id derives from (life, tick, verb, index, ok).

verb.description: The action verb (`do`) or, for an intent, its program name.

index.description: Position in the batch (0 to 5); 0 for an intent.

reason.description: The action's failure reason code. Present only when ok is false.

message.description: Short fixed text, for example 'Your mine failed: the way was blocked.'

intent.description: True when the event is for an intent (a program), not an immediate action.

why.description: For a failed intent: the plain-words reason, a fixed template keyed by program and reason.
